interface.title: PanKEGG (Flask web app over a PanKEGG SQLite database)
interface.field: Metagenomics / microbial ecology (metagenome-assembled genomes, KEGG functional annotation)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring results after binning, CheckM2 quality checks, Sourmash/GTDB-Tk taxonomy and EggNOG annotation are finished
interface.what_it_is_for: Browse the bins (MAGs) of several metagenome samples by quality and taxonomy, inspect how complete their KEGG pathways are, look up KEGG orthologs, and compare samples or bins with heatmaps, scatterplots, PCA and taxonomy composition charts.

data.note: The repository's bundled data/pankegg.db (Sourmash test dataset) holds three samples: Sample_1_test (69 bins), Sample2_comebin (38 bins) and Sample3_fly (23 bins). Some Sample3_fly SemiBin bins have no CheckM2 values (shown as 'None'). Most bins are Firmicutes. There is no sign-in and nothing to upload.

tree.general: Understand how a set of reconstructed genomes from several environmental samples differ in quality, taxonomy and metabolic potential
tree.specific: Explore the MAG bins in pankegg.db: check CheckM2 quality, filter by taxonomy, assess KEGG pathway completeness, trace KOs, and compare samples and bins

features.name: Faceted genome table with sort, quality gate and scoped text search
features.general: Narrow a grouped table of items: choose a sort key, switch on a pass/fail quality threshold, pick which fields a free-text search looks in, then run the search
features.specific: Bin page: Sort by Bin Name/Completeness/Contamination, GTDB quality filtering switch, 'Search in' checkboxes (Sample, Bin, Kingdom…Species), search box (also accepts 'unclassified' for a rank)
steps: switch quality filtering on or off
tick the fields to search in
type a term and press Search
serves_tasks: Rank genomes by a quality score
Hide genomes that fail a standard quality threshold
Find genomes belonging to a named taxon

features.name: Per-group quality scatter in a pop-up window
features.general: From a group header, open a scatter of two quality measures for that group's items, coloured by pass/fail, and inspect points by hovering
features.specific: Generate Plot on a sample row opens a Completeness vs Contamination Plotly scatter, coloured by whether bins meet the GTDB filter
steps: press Generate Plot on a sample
hover points to read bin, completeness and contamination
use the Plotly zoom and pan tools
serves_tasks: Plot completeness against contamination for one sample

features.name: Pathway completeness table with context chips and gene highlight
features.general: Set the scope with removable chips (groups or individual items), filter pathways by name or by a gene ID, read a completion ring per pathway, expand the detected genes (the searched gene highlighted), and export the table
features.specific: Map page: Sample/Bin radio with autocomplete chips, 'Search Map Number or Pathway Name', 'Filter by KO ID', Filter/Clear, a completion donut per map, Toggle ko_ids (dark blue = officially in the pathway, light blue = not, orange = searched KO), Export Current State to CSV (header names the search only, not the chips)
steps: choose Sample or Bin mode and add chips
type a pathway name or KO and press Filter
press Toggle ko_ids to see the detected KOs
press Export Current State to download a CSV
serves_tasks: Measure pathway completeness for a whole sample and narrow it to one pathway
See which pathways a gene function belongs to, with the gene highlighted
Export the filtered pathway list
See the metabolic potential of a whole taxon

features.name: Copy detected genes for an external pathway viewer
features.general: Open a side panel listing the detected gene IDs for one pathway, copy them to the clipboard in one go, and jump to the external pathway viewer to paste them
features.specific: Highlight pathways opens an offcanvas panel with the KO list, Copy to Clipboard (newline-separated KOs; may need a second press while the panel slides in) and a Go to KEGG button
steps: press Highlight pathways on a map row
press Go to KEGG and paste into the map search
serves_tasks: List which genes were detected in a pathway and take them elsewhere

features.name: Gene-function lookup with expandable occurrence details
features.general: Search a catalogue of gene functions by pattern and expand a hit to see every item and group that carries it with its annotations
features.specific: KEGG page: 'Search by pattern', and per KO View Details (bin, sample, GO-terms, EggNOG KO and description), plus View Bins, View Maps, KEGG info and Export Current State
steps: type a KO name or ID and search
press View Maps or View Bins to change view
serves_tasks: Find a gene function by name and see which genomes and samples carry it
See which pathways a gene function belongs to, with the gene highlighted

features.name: Rank-level taxon roll-up with links to other views
features.general: Choose a taxonomic rank, see each taxon with how many items it holds, and jump to that taxon's items, pathways or genes
features.specific: Taxonomy page: level dropdown (Kingdom…Species) and a table of Name / Bins Associated with Bins, Maps and Kegg buttons
steps: read the bin counts per taxon
press Bins, Maps or Kegg for a taxon
serves_tasks: Count how many genomes each taxon holds at a chosen rank
See the metabolic potential of a whole taxon

features.name: Category-filtered paired heatmaps
features.general: For two chosen groups, pick functional categories from a checklist and draw side-by-side items × pathways heatmaps coloured by completeness, with a panel that names the pathways
features.specific: Sample vs Sample Heatmap: Show all options shows KEGG BRITE pathway groups (1.1 Carbohydrate…7.11); Apply Filter draws one heatmap per sample per group; Map Details opens the list of map names
steps: hover cells or press Map Details
serves_tasks: Compare pathway completeness per genome within chosen pathway categories

features.name: Paired quality scatter with threshold legend
features.general: Show a two-measure quality scatter for each of two groups side by side, coloured by whether items pass a threshold; hide a class from the legend and hover points
features.specific: Sample vs Sample Scatterplot section (Show/Hide): Completeness vs Contamination per sample, coloured by GTDB filter; clicking a legend marker (not its text) hides 'Bins not meeting GTDB filter' and rescales the axes
steps: click a legend marker to hide a group
serves_tasks: Compare genome quality between the two samples

features.name: Paired clustered PCA of items
features.general: Show a clustered PCA of the items in each of two groups side by side and identify points by hovering
features.specific: Sample vs Sample Bin PCA section (Show/Hide): one clustered PCA of bins per sample; hover shows the bin name
serves_tasks: See how genomes cluster within each sample

features.name: Per-entity pathway carrier counts with bar chart
features.general: For two chosen entities, list each pathway with how many items in each entity carry it and the sum of the two (not their overlap), search the table by name, and view the same counts as a grouped bar chart
features.specific: Common Pathways section in Sample vs Sample and in Bin vs Bin. The per-entity columns count bins carrying the pathway (0/1 in green/red in Bin vs Bin); 'Both' is their sum. Search/reset box and a 'Common Pathways Counts' Plotly bar chart
steps: choose two samples (or a sample then a bin on each side)
press Toggle Pathways Table or Show/Hide
type a pathway name and press Search

features.name: Rank-selectable stacked composition chart

steps: read the stacked bars, labels and legend

features.name: Pathway × taxon count heatmap for one group

serves_tasks: Relate pathways to taxa within one sample

features.name: Feature-space selectable PCA of samples
features.general: Ordinate all groups by a chosen feature set (genes, pathways or taxa at a chosen rank), report explained variance, and identify points by hovering
features.specific: PCA Comparison: 'Select PCA Type' (Based on KOs / Maps / Taxonomy, plus a Taxonomy Level dropdown) gives a PC1/PC2 scatter and an Explained Variance line
serves_tasks: Ordinate all samples to see which are most alike

features.name: Row-level cross-links between views
features.general: From any row (an item, a pathway, a gene function or a taxon), jump to a related view already filtered to that row, so the analysis can pivot between items, pathways, genes and taxa
features.specific: Maps / Kegg on a bin row (/map?bin_id=…), View Bins on a map row (/bin?map_number=…), View Maps / View Bins on a KO (/map?ko_id=…), Bins / Maps / Kegg on a taxon row (/map?taxon=…)
steps: press its Maps, Kegg, View Bins or View Maps button
read the filtered view, whose title names the filter
serves_tasks: See how complete each pathway is for one genome
Find all genomes that carry a given pathway
See which pathways a gene function belongs to, with the gene highlighted
See the metabolic potential of a whole taxon
